text:
anya: quick heads-up — ACME enterprise asked for two things they want shipped together: (1) per-tenant legal-hold (prevents deletes + marks exports), and (2) sampled audit-log export to customer S3 with BYOK handshake. they want an acceptance date in Q3. can we scope?

matt: do we already have a tenant-level flag for legal-hold? i thought we only had account-level retention currently.

samir: no tenant flag yet. we have retention TTL + snapshotting. legal-hold would need to override TTL and block purges and retention-based archival. also needs signal for evidence exports.

frances: two product questions: what does "sampled export" mean operationally? full export is heavy (TBs), sampling could be time-window or event-type. also need clear legal acceptance criteria (legal signoff). @legal-bot can you confirm minimal evidence format?

legal-bot: legal: acceptable export schema = JSONL with event_type, timestamp, actor_id, request_id, resource_id, details. must include verifiable hashes for chain-of-custody. Export manifest must include key thumbprint if BYOK used.

nate: rough numbers: for a 10TB/day audit stream, a 1% time-window sample ~ 100GB/day. indexing/searchability concerns. we should specify whether sampled exports are raw or indexed slices.

anya: proposal: MVP = per-tenant legal-hold flag + a sampled export job that can be configured per-tenant (window %, or event-type whitelist). no realtime search SLA for exported blobs — just S3 objects + manifest. source retention still enforces legal-hold.

matt: implementation notes: legal-hold should be metadata on tenant object -> when true, purge jobs skip. purge path currently: purge service consults retention config; add hold check. also add an admin API to set/unset holds and audit who toggled it.

samir: BYOK handoff: we need a handshake flow — customer provides a KEK public key, we create an ephemeral wrapping key for export, we wrap per-export DEKs, and include key thumbprint in manifest. rotation/escrow questions for SOC2.

frances: launch criteria suggestion: 1) hold prevents purge for 30-day test tenants; 2) export produces manifest + object in customer S3 with valid key thumbprint; 3) data schema validated against legal sample set; 4) e2e runbook created for ops; 5) SOC2 evidentiary peer review done.

anya: can engineering estimate dev + QA? prefer separate small epic for API + purge changes, export worker + BYOK, and ops/runbook. no need for UI for MVP — admin API + console log link is fine.

matt: initial estimate: API + purge changes = 3 devs 2 sprints; export worker + BYOK = 2 devs 3 sprints (crypto review included); QA + runbook = 2 sprints. overall ~6-8 weeks if parallel.

nate: infra questions: ephemeral export workers will need temporary creds to write to customer S3. recommend pre-signed URLs pattern to avoid long-lived creds. also throttling and backpressure if customer bucket errors.

samir: risk notes: BYOK crypto path increases complexity for support (key rotation failure modes). must include fallback manual export path for emergency. also need retention metrics so we can show customers proof-of-hold.

frances: product tradeoffs to call out in roadmap: full searchability vs export size; immediate hold enforcement vs eventual consistency (purge job timing); automated legal notifications vs manual signoff. which do we prioritize for Q3?

anya: suggestion for Q3 MVP scope (minimal): a) API + enforcement for legal-hold, b) sampled export worker writing JSONL to S3 + manifest with key thumbprint, c) BYOK handshake for exports, d) ops runbook + SOC2 evidence pack prepared. defer UI and full indexed exports to later.

matt: +1 to MVP. add monitoring: export success rate, bytes exported per tenant, hold-duration histograms, purge-skip counts. set SLO: export job median completion < 30m for 100GB slices.

nate: i'll prototype pre-signed pattern and simulated bucket failures for the export worker tests.

samir: i'll schedule a crypto consult and draft the BYOK handshake doc.

frances: i'll coordinate legal signoff and build the acceptance checklist.

anya: thanks team. can we mark this as P0 for Q3 enterprise blockers board? i'll create the epic and link to this thread. :thumbsup:

matt: cool — drop the epic link here when ready.

legal-bot: legal: note — for some customers we may need escrow/third-party key escrow; flag for sales conversations.

anya: noted. end of thread.
